main.description: Who is signed in to the appview, from the session cookie. Never calls the authorization server.

scopes.description: The OAuth scopes the session was granted.

csrfToken.description: Sent as X-CSRF-Token on every state-changing request.

errors.name: SessionExpired
errors.description: The session ended (idle, refused renewal, or new sign-in scopes). The body also carries the session's handle, to sign the same person back in.
